children: SPCX rose 6% early Friday after a nearly 13% two-day drop. Deutsche Bank reaffirmed its buy rating and $250 target, saying political retaliation risks for Elon Musk may be overstated.
- NASA added $946 million to Space Exploration Technologies Corp (SPCX)’s astronaut transportation contract in September, bringing the contract’s total value to $5.92 billion.
Space Exploration Technologies Corp (SPCX) and Tesla are building Terafab, a chip fabrication research facility at Gigafactory Texas designed to accelerate testing of new chip designs.
AT&T and T-Mobile reportedly discussed ending Boost Mobile’s network access if SPCX acquires the carrier, though neither has decided to act. The deal may require both operators’ approval.
Space Exploration Technologies (SPCX) said in its S-1 filing that U.S. agencies would supply about 20% of 2025 revenue, above Elon Musk’s recent estimate.
SPCX board director Donald Harrison resigned effective Nov. 4 after more than a decade. Elon Musk cited conflicts of interest involving Alphabet; the company said the exit was not tied to disputes.
Scottish Mortgage cut SpaceX (SPCX) to 11.1% of assets from 15% at Sept. 30, citing portfolio discipline rather than lower confidence.
• Space Exploration Technologies Corp (SPCX): Google reported increasing its shareholding from 551.2 million shares to approximately 555 million shares.
